passages.text: Many companies that once required daily office attendance now allow employees to work from home several days a week. This change began during the pandemic but has continued because both workers and managers discovered advantages. Employees save time and money on commuting and can better balance family responsibilities. Companies reduce the cost of large office spaces. Productivity has not fallen in most studies. In fact, some teams report higher output when people can concentrate without constant interruptions. However, remote work is not without problems. Some workers feel isolated and miss informal conversations that used to happen in the office. Managers worry that younger employees receive less guidance when they are not physically present. Technical issues, such as unreliable internet connections, can also slow progress. To address these concerns, many organizations have introduced hybrid schedules. Staff come to the office two or three days a week for meetings and collaboration, then work remotely on other days. Clear written guidelines help everyone understand expectations about availability and response times. Digital tools for video calls and shared documents make communication easier than it was a decade ago. Still, success depends on trust. When managers focus on results rather than hours spent online, employees tend to perform well. Surveys show that most adults prefer some flexibility and would consider leaving a job that demanded five full days in the office. The shift is unlikely to reverse completely. Companies that adapt their culture to support both independent work and occasional in-person contact are more likely to attract and keep skilled staff.

Adults who regularly sleep less than seven hours a night face higher risks of several health problems. Doctors have long known that insufficient sleep raises the chance of heart disease, high blood pressure, and type 2 diabetes. Recent research also links short sleep to weaker immune responses and slower recovery from illness. Many people believe they can catch up on weekends, yet studies show that irregular sleep patterns still harm the body. The brain needs consistent rest to clear waste products that accumulate during waking hours. Without enough sleep, concentration, memory, and decision-making suffer. Drivers who are tired cause accidents at rates similar to those who have been drinking. Shift workers and parents of young children often struggle to maintain regular hours. Screens in the bedroom make the problem worse because blue light delays the release of melatonin, the hormone that signals sleep. Experts recommend a fixed bedtime, a cool dark room, and no caffeine after mid-afternoon. Exercise helps, but intense workouts close to bedtime can delay sleep. Some adults turn to sleep medication, yet long-term use can create dependence and does not restore natural sleep quality. Simple changes, such as reading a book instead of scrolling on a phone, often prove more effective. Employers who allow flexible start times report fewer sick days among staff. Protecting sleep is not a luxury. It is a basic requirement for physical and mental performance in daily life.

In many large cities, the price of buying or renting a home has risen faster than average wages. Young adults who finish their studies often find that even a modest apartment requires a large share of their monthly income. Long commutes from cheaper suburbs add time and transport costs. Some cities have responded by building more high-rise apartments and by changing zoning rules that once limited height and density. Others offer subsidies or low-interest loans to first-time buyers. Critics argue that new construction alone does not solve the problem if most new units remain expensive. They point to the need for stronger rent controls and more public housing. Supporters of market solutions claim that controls reduce the incentive to build and can lead to fewer available homes. Meanwhile, some residents leave the city center for smaller towns where remote work makes daily presence unnecessary. This movement has raised prices in previously affordable areas. Community groups in several cities organize shared housing or cooperative ownership models to keep costs lower. Local governments face pressure from both sides. Too little new building leaves prices high. Too rapid construction without accompanying schools, parks, and transport strains existing services. Finding a balance requires data on actual demand, clear planning rules, and cooperation between private builders and public authorities. Without such measures, many working adults will continue to spend a large portion of their earnings on housing.

passages.title_en: Saving and Investing for the Future
passages.text: Most adults know they should save money, yet many find it difficult to put aside a regular amount. Unexpected expenses, rising prices, and the desire for immediate purchases compete with long-term goals. Financial advisers usually recommend an emergency fund covering three to six months of essential costs before any other investment. Once that buffer exists, people can consider longer-term options such as pension contributions or low-cost index funds. These funds track the overall market rather than trying to pick individual winning stocks. Historical data show that broad market returns have been positive over periods of ten years or more, although short-term losses remain possible. High fees charged by some managed funds reduce the final amount an investor keeps. Automatic transfers from a salary account into a separate savings or investment account help many people stay consistent. Interest rates on ordinary bank savings have been low in recent years, so money left only in a checking account loses purchasing power to inflation. Younger workers who start early benefit from compound growth even with modest monthly sums. Older adults closer to retirement may prefer safer assets and should review their risk tolerance carefully. Government tax incentives for retirement accounts encourage participation. Still, no strategy removes all risk. Understanding basic terms, reading clear fee information, and avoiding pressure from salespeople improve the chance of meeting future needs. Regular small actions matter more than occasional large deposits.

nodes.feedback_try: השורה 'This movement has raised prices in previously affordable areas' מראה שג נכונה.
nodes.worked_method: חפשו remote work או movement ובדקו את ההשפעה על מחירים.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מה נדרש כדי למצוא איזון לפי הקטע?
nodes.body_content: [ps_03] According to the passage, finding a balance requires what?

choices.label: Data on demand, clear planning rules, and cooperation.
choices.feedback: הקטע מציין שנדרשים נתונים על ביקוש, כללי תכנון ברורים ושיתוף פעולה.

nodes.feedback_ok: נדרשים נתונים, כללים ברורים ושיתוף פעולה.
nodes.feedback_try: המשפט 'Finding a balance requires data on actual demand, clear planning rules, and cooperation between private builders and public authorities' תומך בב.
nodes.worked_method: חפשו Finding a balance ובדקו מה נדרש.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מהי אחת הביקורות על בנייה חדשה בלבד?
nodes.body_content: [ps_03] What is one criticism of relying only on new construction?

choices.label: It always solves the problem completely.
Most new units remain expensive.
choices.feedback: המבקרים טוענים שבנייה חדשה לבדה לא פותרת אם רוב היחידות החדשות נשארות יקרות.

choices.label: It is supported by all critics.

nodes.feedback_ok: הביקורת היא שרוב היחידות החדשות נשארות יקרות.
nodes.feedback_try: המשפט 'Critics argue that new construction alone does not solve the problem if most new units remain expensive' תומך בב.
nodes.worked_method: אתרו Critics argue ובדקו מה הם טוענים על בנייה.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מה ממליצים יועצים פיננסיים לפני השקעות אחרות?
nodes.body_content: [ps_04] What do financial advisers usually recommend before other investments?

choices.label: An emergency fund of three to six months of essential costs.
choices.feedback: הקטע אומר שיועצים ממליצים על קרן חירום של שלושה עד שישה חודשים לפני כל השקעה אחרת.

nodes.feedback_ok: מומלצת קרן חירום של שלושה עד שישה חודשים.
nodes.feedback_try: המשפט 'Financial advisers usually recommend an emergency fund covering three to six months of essential costs before any other investment' תומך בב.
nodes.worked_method: חפשו recommend ובדקו מה בא לפני השקעות אחרות.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מה מאפיין index funds לפי הקטע?
nodes.body_content: [ps_04] What do index funds do according to the passage?

choices.label: They try to pick individual winning stocks.
They charge the highest possible fees.
They track the overall market.
choices.feedback: הקטע אומר שקרנות אלה עוקבות אחרי השוק הכללי במקום לנסות לבחור מניות מנצחות.

nodes.feedback_ok: index funds עוקבות אחרי השוק הכללי.
nodes.feedback_try: השורה 'These funds track the overall market rather than trying to pick individual winning stocks' מראה שג נכונה.
nodes.worked_method: אתרו index funds ובדקו מה הן עושות.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מה קורה לכסף שנשאר רק בחשבון עובר ושב לפי הקטע?
nodes.body_content: [ps_04] What happens to money left only in a checking account according to the passage?

choices.label: It loses purchasing power to inflation.
choices.feedback: הקטע אומר שכסף שנשאר רק בחשבון עובר ושב מאבד כוח קנייה בגלל אינפלציה.

choices.label: It is protected from all risk.

nodes.feedback_ok: הכסף מאבד כוח קנייה בגלל אינפלציה.
nodes.feedback_try: המשפט 'money left only in a checking account loses purchasing power to inflation' תומך בב.
nodes.worked_method: חפשו checking account ובדקו מה קורה לכסף שם.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מי נהנה במיוחד מהתחלה מוקדמת של חיסכון?
nodes.body_content: [ps_04] Who benefits especially from starting to save early?

choices.label: Younger workers, because of compound growth.
choices.feedback: הקטע אומר שעובדים צעירים שמתחילים מוקדם נהנים מצמיחה מורכבת גם עם סכומים קטנים.

nodes.feedback_ok: עובדים צעירים נהנים מצמיחה מורכבת.
nodes.feedback_try: השורה 'Younger workers who start early benefit from compound growth even with modest monthly sums' תומכת בד.
nodes.worked_method: חפשו Younger workers ובדקו מדוע הם נהנים.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מה חשוב יותר לפי הקטע, פעולות קטנות סדירות או הפקדות גדולות מדי פעם?
nodes.body_content: [ps_04] According to the passage, what matters more?

choices.label: Regular small actions.
choices.feedback: הקטע מסכם שפעולות קטנות סדירות חשובות יותר מהפקדות גדולות מדי פעם.

nodes.feedback_ok: פעולות קטנות סדירות חשובות יותר.
nodes.feedback_try: המשפט האחרון 'Regular small actions matter more than occasional large deposits' מראה שב נכונה.
nodes.worked_method: חפשו את המשפט האחרון של הקטע.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מה משמעות subsidies בהקשר של דיור?
nodes.body_content: In the passage, subsidies most nearly means

choices.label: financial help or support from the government.
choices.feedback: subsidies הן סיוע כספי, כאן לרוכשים ראשונים.

nodes.feedback_ok: subsidies הן סיוע כספי.
nodes.feedback_try: ההקשר 'offer subsidies or low-interest loans to first-time buyers' מראה שהכוונה לסיוע. לכן א.
nodes.worked_method: בדקו מה מוצע יחד עם low-interest loans.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מה משמעות incentive בהקשר של בנייה?
nodes.body_content: The word incentive in 'reduce the incentive to build' most nearly means

choices.label: a reason or motivation to do something.
choices.feedback: incentive הוא תמריץ או סיבה לעשות משהו.

nodes.feedback_ok: incentive הוא תמריץ או מוטיבציה.
nodes.feedback_try: ההקשר של reduce the incentive to build מראה שהכוונה למוטיבציה. לכן א.
nodes.worked_method: חשבו מה מפחיתים כשאומרים reduce the incentive.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מה משמעות compound growth?
nodes.body_content: Compound growth in the passage most nearly means

choices.label: growth that stops after one year.
growth where earnings also earn returns over time.
choices.feedback: compound growth הוא צמיחה שבה הרווחים עצמם מניבים תשואה נוספת.

nodes.feedback_ok: compound growth הוא צמיחה מורכבת שבה הרווחים צומחים.
nodes.feedback_try: ההקשר של start early benefit from compound growth מראה על צמיחה מצטברת. לכן ב.
nodes.worked_method: חפשו את ההסבר סביב younger workers ו-compound.
nodes.hint: חשבו על רווחים שמייצרים עוד רווחים.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: מה משמעות purchasing power?
nodes.body_content: Purchasing power most nearly means

choices.label: the amount of goods or services money can buy.
choices.feedback: purchasing power הוא כוח הקנייה של הכסף.

choices.label: the interest rate on a loan.

nodes.feedback_ok: purchasing power הוא מה שהכסף יכול לקנות.
nodes.feedback_try: ההקשר loses purchasing power to inflation מראה שהכוונה לערך הקנייה. לכן א.
nodes.worked_method: חשבו מה קורה כשאינפלציה משפיעה על כסף.

nodes.title: בדיקה
nodes.body_he: בחרו את צורת הסביל הנכונה.
nodes.body_content: New apartments _____ in several cities last year.

choices.label: were built
choices.feedback: הנושא הוא apartments, הפעולה נעשתה עליהם, לכן סביל בעבר.

nodes.feedback_try: apartments הוא רבים. הפעולה נעשתה עליהם בעבר. לכן were built. ב.
nodes.worked_method: בדקו אם הנושא עושה את הפעולה או שהפעולה נעשית עליו, ואת הזמן.

nodes.title: בדיקה

nodes.worked_method: בדקו איזה מודאל מביע עצה, וודאו שאין to אחריו.

nodes.body_he: בחרו את צורת ההשוואה הנכונה.

choices.label: more
choices.feedback: more effective הוא צורת ההשוואה.

choices.feedback: הסיום מסכם את הטיעון המרכזי.
